title: Physical Health
body: Check in with how you feel. Sleep, movement, and regular checkups help you stay well. Ask a peer or clinic if something feels off.

title: Mental Health
summary: Support for your mind and mood.
body: Feeling stressed or low is common. Talking with a peer, counselor, or trusted person can help. Crisis lines are under Help Now.

title: Nutrition
body: You do not need a perfect diet. Aim for regular meals when you can, drink water, and ask your clinic about food resources nearby.

title: Exercise
summary: Move in ways that fit your day.
body: Walking, stretching, or light activity counts. Start small. Stop if you feel pain, and ask a provider before starting a new routine.

title: Medications
summary: Keep track of what you take.
body: Know the name, dose, and why you take each medicine. Use My Health as a memory aid — not medical advice. Ask your pharmacist questions.

title: Preventive Care
body: Vaccines and checkups can catch problems early. Ask your clinic which ones are right for you this year.
